lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters situated posterior to the pectoral fin and extending across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance clusters to form a structured grid of nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features displaying a sharp vertical pixel gradient (highlighted upper edge, shadowed lower edge) running parallel to the longitudinal axis on the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance blobs distributed across the surface area within the visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or indentation on the posterior trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five commensal fish (remoras) clustered around the ventral-lateral area posterior to the pectoral fin.
